title: Configure beads (br/bv) in physlib fork
close_reason: beads initialized (prefix physlib, br+bv); commit eb1fa9fd on branch beads-setup

comments.author: m
comments.text:
Micro-review of eb1fa9fd and 37eca4e8 is docs/reviews/20261125-100043-lean-toolchain-and-beads-setup.md, commit ff67aabf. That commit contains only the review file. CLAUDE.md was not edited. Local master was not moved. The staged .claude/learning-seeds.md was left out.

physlib-tov tracks the two warnings. CLAUDE.md names .beads/beads.jsonl and jq '.quick_ref' / '.recommendations[0]'. The file on disk is .beads/issues.jsonl, and on bv 0.2.1 those triage keys are under .triage. The session summary line 15 says doctor reports everything OK. br doctor is healthy and still prints warnings (literal .write.lock pattern, WAL without SHM, missing beads.base.jsonl anchor, orphaned write lock at review time).

elan is exported from ~/.profile line 49 only. ~/.zshenv has no elan line, so a new non-login shell still needs PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH".

Do not re-file the doctor nits: *.lock already ignores .write.lock, the WAL/SHM note is expected for frankensqlite, and beads.base.jsonl is a gitignored local merge anchor. physlib-omp stays the needs-human master reset.

title: Reset local master to origin/master (drop 2 stray tooling commits)
description:
Local master is 2 commits ahead of origin/master: ca04e9c1 (an unfilled session-summary template a Stop hook committed) and eaa8acc6 ("add project": .beads, CLAUDE.md, an empty .env and a Node package.json). The beads setup now sits cleanly on branch beads-setup (commit eb1fa9fd, without .env, package.json or the template). The dcg guard blocks agents from moving the master ref.

Check first: `git -C ~/wk/physlib log --oneline origin/master..master` should list exactly eaa8acc6 and ca04e9c1.

Command: `git -C ~/wk/physlib branch -f master origin/master`

Done when: `git -C ~/wk/physlib rev-list --count origin/master..master` prints 0.

title: Correct CLAUDE.md bv paths and the doctor line in the beads session summary
description:
Micro-review: docs/reviews/20261125-100043-lean-toolchain-and-beads-setup.md (commit ff67aabf on beads-setup).

CLAUDE.md tells agents the issues file is .beads/beads.jsonl (lines 8, 71, and 92). The file on disk is .beads/issues.jsonl. There is no beads.jsonl.

Lines 83-84 pipe bv --robot-triage into jq '.quick_ref' and jq '.recommendations[0]'. Those keys sit under .triage. Checked 2026-11-25 on bv 0.2.1: top-level keys are data_hash, generated_at, output_format, triage, usage_hints, and version. quick_ref and recommendations are inside triage. The working filters are jq '.triage.quick_ref' and jq '.triage.recommendations[0]'.

docs/session-summaries/2026-11-25-100500-lean-toolchain-and-beads-setup.md line 15 says br doctor reports everything OK. br doctor is healthy and also prints warnings: .beads/.gitignore has no literal .write.lock pattern (*.lock already ignores the lock), a WAL sidecar without SHM (doctor calls this expected for frankensqlite), a missing .beads/beads.base.jsonl merge anchor after last_export_time 2026-11-25T17:56:49Z, and at review time an orphaned .write.lock. Correct that sentence so the next reader sees the warnings.

Done when the CLAUDE.md triage examples match a live bv --robot-triage payload, and the session summary no longer says doctor is free of warnings.

Leave .beads/beads.base.jsonl uncommitted (it is gitignored). Leave local master alone (physlib-omp). Keep this docs fix on beads-setup, off any branch opened toward leanprover-community/physlib.

The elan PATH export lives only in ~/.profile (line 49), not in ~/.zshenv. That is outside this repository and is not part of this issue.
